line: A computer says AI wrote your essay. You wrote it.
Show your version history. Show your notes. Ask how often it is wrong.
Here's why. The checker Turnitin says it makes this mistake less than one time in a hundred.
Vanderbilt University does the math. Seventy-five thousand submissions. About seven hundred fifty could have been called AI by mistake.
Stanford tests seven other tools. About six in ten essays by people still learning English get called AI.
Save this. Send this to your friend who writes essays.
Did a computer ever say AI wrote your essay?
